desc: Build adjacency list from `edges` storing (neighbor, length).
Implement recursive DFS with parameters `(node, parent, depth)` using `sys.setrecursionlimit(10**6)`.
Maintain `pref` list of cumulative edge lengths (start with `[0]` at depth 0).
Maintain `last_occ` dict (value → last depth) and `start_depth` integer for sliding window.
On visiting node with value `v`: update `start_depth` if `v` seen at depth `>= start_depth`, then set `last_occ[v] = depth`.
Compute candidate `cur_len = pref[depth] - pref[start_depth]` and `cur_nodes = depth - start_depth + 1`; update global best.
Backtrack state: store previous `start_depth` and remove value from `last_occ` after exploring subtree.
Test edge cases: n=2 with duplicate root value, linear tree with all unique values, all duplicate values.
